references.text: The fundamental command that all firstborn belong to the Lord, both humans and animals.
Everything that opens the womb shall be consecrated to the Lord, including the firstborn of livestock.
The firstborn of oxen and sheep shall be given to the Lord on the eighth day.
Everything that opens the womb belongs to the Lord, including the firstborn of cattle and sheep.
All firstborn belong to the Lord from the day he struck down the firstborn in Egypt.
All firstborn in Israel, both humans and animals, belong to the Lord.
The firstborn of unclean animals shall be redeemed, but the firstborn of ox, sheep, or goat shall not be redeemed because they are holy.
All firstborn male animals of cattle and sheep shall be consecrated to the Lord.
